runtime: Same Codex assistant using course ChatGPT-style interactive prompt workflow; no separate inference API
rules: Assistant authored/evaluated outputs after reading the candidate instructions and common case. Python serializes authored content, assembles original prompt packets and validates artifacts; it does not perform model inference. Shared broad wording is an intentional source control, not independent repeatability.
limits: No field trial, tenant test, independent model judge, probability of accuracy or measured ROI.
Original weak outputs are attributed historical evidence, not fabricated fresh failures.
Common outputs normalize lengthy candidate prose for the frozen contract; comparative observations are qualitative, not scored model performance.
